newsitem.title: BELGIUM: IFOR set to become SFOR.
newsitem.headline: IFOR set to become SFOR.

text.p: NATO's military force in Bosnia is likely to change its name from IFOR to SFOR next year, representing a change in the alliance-led force's purpose, a NATO official said on Monday.
IFOR, standing for Implementation Force, will become SFOR, standing for Stabilisation Force, the officials said.
Ambassadors of the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation agreed on Monday to prepare for a force of between 25,000 and 30,000 in Bosnia next year after the IFOR mandate runs out on December 20.

"There is a general desire in the alliance to show that it is a new force," the official said, adding that the force's role would be to stabilise what as been achieved rather than implement a peace plan.
